hpi: This case highlights the importance of recognizing septic arthritis in patients presenting with joint pain and swelling. Early diagnosis and treatment are crucial to prevent joint damage. Key considerations include obtaining joint fluid for analysis and starting appropriate antibiotics. The differential diagnosis should include other causes of joint pain, such as gout and trauma.
